title: Preamble: On the Reason for the Shape of the Wine Barrel
author: Johannes Kepler
full_title: Nova stereometria doliorum vinariorum, inprimis Austriaci, figurae omnium aptissimae; et usus in eo virgae cubicae compendiosissimus et plane singularis. Accessit stereometriae Archimedeae supplementum
source: The preamble to Kepler's *Nova stereometria doliorum vinariorum* (Linz: Johannes Planck, at the author's expense, 1615).
transcribed_from: the [page images](https://doi.org/10.3931/e-rara-11051) of the copy in the ETH-Bibliothek, Zürich (Rar 356: 1 q), on e-rara.
summary: Why wine is kept in wooden casks bound with hoops, and why the hoops force the cask into a round shape between a cylinder and a pair of cones, which makes it open to geometrical measurement.
